hec.model

Class PreferencesManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • hec.model.PreferencesManager
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    PreferencesConstants

    public class PreferencesManager
extends java.lang.Object
implements PreferencesConstants
    class to store the Preferences for the user preferences can be read from 4 locations: users/CWMS/All/preferences/... -> CWMS_ALL users/CWMS//preferences/... -> CWMS_WATERSHED users//All/preferences/... -> USER_ALL users///preferences/... -> USER_WATERSHED preferences can be written to 2 locations: users//All/preferences/... -> USER_ALL users///preferences/... -> USER_WATERSHED Preferences are file based. To store a preference in the file d.pref for a user for a specific watershed for a specific application (ie res) use setUserPreference(USER_WATERSHED,"res/d.pref")
